doc: Dash -> ability rows (DashFlow, docs/decisions/0010-dash-ability-flow.md). dash.<ground|air>.<lmb|rmb|e|x|q>: {mode: fire (mid-dash) | buffer (to the dash's end; the default for a missing row) | cancel (ends the dash), carry: dash momentum kept into it, variant: a dash-variant name the kit reads, source: what the source hero does}. into_dash.<slot>: the same for Shift pressed during that ability's wind-up or recovery. kit_owns: the dashes (ground, air) the kit runs in its own state, out of DashFlow's sight until it overrides ArchKit.in_dash(). Dancer: ThiefKit.fires_in_dash reads dash.*.lmb.mode and ThiefKit._empowers reads dash.*.lmb.variant; a move another press starts mid-cartwheel waits out the flip (ThiefKit.play). Combo rows (docs/decisions/0015-combo-flow.md): jump.<slot> (a press mid-jump: fire | buffer to the landing), into_jump.<slot> (a jump in the ability's wind-up or recovery: fire | cancel | buffer | lock; into_dash takes the same modes and an optional air sub-row), hold.<slot>.<ground|air|jump|mantle> (a held slot through that move: keep | cancel). A missing row combines; any other row is an exception and carries a reason and a source. held_fire.<dash|rmb|e|x|q|all>: {source, ours}: notes for the held-LMB rows (docs only: LMB is a held input everywhere, Hunter.trigger reads the key every frame and fire resumes the frame a slot's lock ends; --held-fire-resume-check). window.source: the footage evidence for the buffer window (DashFlow.BUFFER_S), shown in docs/heroes/dash_interactions.md. dash_jump.<ground|air|rise|same>: Space in a ground dash, Space in an air dash, Shift in a jump's rise, both on one step: {ours: cancel | both | ignore | end | buffer | dash (measured, --dash-jump-check), carry: share of the dash's speed kept, source, verdict: match | [?] (the source doesn't settle it)}.

glide_rows.source: Owner rule, briefs/DECISIONS.md 2026-11-08: Shift cancels into glide instantly for every Hunter; glide opens only on a press, never a hold. Source rows for this dash: the air dash rows above.
glide_rows.ours: a fresh press ends the dash that step and the glider opens the next, keeping the dash speed up to the handoff cap. Her air Shift is the 0.9 s Cartwheel glide-dash: the press ends it. Asserted in --airdash-glide-check.
